name: FV_BE_TRANSACTIONS_INT
description: This table contains budget execution interface record information

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: User populated interface records group identifier per import

columns.name: INTERFACE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: User populated unique Interface record number with in group

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Interface load request identifier

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Ledger name associated with this transaction.

columns.name: BUDGET_LEVEL_NAME
columns.description: Budget level associated with this document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Header description of the document.

columns.name: BUDGETARY_CONTROL_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Budget control type of the transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Name used to identifiy the budgetary debit and credit accounts to be used for the transaction line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Document number of the transaction.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget distribution amount of this transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction line was accounted.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY
columns.description: Federal agency identifier associated with this transaction.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Agency main account code associated with this transaction.

columns.name: PUBLIC_LAW_CODE
columns.description: Public law code for the associated transaction line. This will have value only if it is required or a budget level.

columns.name: REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Reduction type for the transaction line. This will have a value only if it is required or a budget level.The value will be one  look up code from lookup type ORA_FV_REDUCTION_TYPE and valid values are ORA_OTH

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Statement that describes this transaction

columns.name: BUDGET_USER_NAME
columns.description: Budget user who created this transaction.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: To identify transaction as processed.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of the interface record - NEW, SUBMITTED ,REJECTED

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source type of the transaction.The value will be one  look up code from lookup type ORA_FV_SOURCE_CODE and valid values are MANUAL,IMPORT,ANTICIPATED

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Error message for validation failure.The value will be  one of the error and warning message defined to handle the budget execution transaction screen.

columns.name: FUND_VALUE
columns.description: Key flexfield balancing segment value

columns.name: BUDGET_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Budget category code for the transaction.

columns.name: PARENT_BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Parent budget level account combination for a budget transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
